about: Voice lines for Overmaster: the heroes, each villain, the monsters of the wilds you parley with (0.31), and each villain's minions (0.33). A category can have variants (cat, cat2, cat3...): the game picks one, never the same twice in a row. elevenlabs_gen.py voices speaks them; pixellab_gen.py talk lip-syncs the portraits; tools/voice_import.py brings both into the game. Edit the text here and redo a line with --redo. 0.38: the weekly assault on Millbrook (heroes: gate, held, tower; villains: council, assault, lead, hold, tower; monsters: charge) and second takes of the battle lines heard most.

brakka.voice: A big, booming male voice in his thirties, a northern raider with a rough Nordic accent, boisterous and full of laughter, loud and confident like a warrior bragging in a tavern.

lines.start: Ha! Finally, something worth swinging at!
lines.danger: Now this is a fight they'll sing about!
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. The bards had better get every detail.
lines.easy: Bah! That wasn't even a warm-up.
lines.down: On your feet! Nobody dies before the song is written!
lines.rest: Even I need sleep. Let's make camp and take a long rest.
lines.explore1: When we're done, every tavern in the north will know my name.
lines.explore2: I smell adventure. Or wet dog. Hard to tell.
lines.levelup: I feel stronger! Bring me a bigger monster!
lines.loot: A fine prize! It will look good in my legend.
lines.town: Millbrook! Ale, a fire, and an audience.
lines.march: To the Dark Tower! This is the verse they'll remember!
lines.boss: So you're the villain. You'll make a fine last chorus!
lines.win: Victory! Sing it loud, sing it forever!
lines.walls: To the walls! Let them climb, I'll knock them down one by one!
lines.wave: They're marching on Millbrook? Not past me, they aren't!
lines.lair: A monster nest! Kick it open and let's see what crawls out!
lines.villain: There! The villain, out in the open! Come and fight me!
lines.dying: Sing it loud... and make me taller in the song...
lines.hired: A new hero for a new song! The name's Brakka. Remember it!
lines.gate: The gate's down! Good! Now they come to me!
lines.held: Ha! Back they run! Millbrook stands, and so do I!
lines.tower: They knocked down a tower? I'll build it again with their bones!
lines.start2: Line up, monsters! One at a time or all at once, I don't mind!
lines.easy2: Is that all? I've had harder fights over the last ale.
lines.hard2: Now that's a fight! My arms are shaking, and I love it!
lines.down2: Not today, friend! Up! There's more killing to do!

thrain.voice: A gravelly, deep male dwarf voice, older, with a thick Scottish accent, gruff and solemn, a warrior bound by an oath, slow and determined.

lines.start: For my grandfather's axe! Stand fast!
lines.danger: Steady now. This one could be the death of us.
lines.hard: That was a hard-fought battle. The hills will remember it.
lines.easy: Barely worth the sharpening of my blade.
lines.down: Hold on, friend! I'll not lose another to the dark!
lines.rest: We're battered and bleeding. Time we took a long rest.
lines.explore1: These hills were green once. We'll make them green again.
lines.explore2: Keep your eyes open. The dark has eyes too.
lines.levelup: My oath grows stronger, and so do I.
lines.loot: Good dwarven craft, this. It'll serve us well.
lines.town: Millbrook still stands. Good. That's why we fight.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. My oath ends where it began.
lines.boss: I swore to drive you out, and a dwarf keeps his word!
lines.win: It's done. Grandfather, rest easy now.
lines.walls: Man the walls! Not one of them sets foot in this town!
lines.wave: An army on the road. Then we meet it on the road.
lines.lair: Another of the villain's burrows. We'll bring it down stone by stone.
lines.villain: That's the villain, walking free as you like. Mark the spot.
lines.dying: Tell my clan... I kept my oath...
lines.hired: The fallen swore an oath. I'll finish it for them.
lines.gate: The gate is breached! Form a wall of steel behind it!
lines.held: They break against us like the sea on stone. Millbrook holds.
lines.tower: A tower falls. We'll mourn it after. Hold the line!
lines.start2: Steady, all. We fight as one, or we fall as one.
lines.easy2: A small fight. Small fights are good. Fewer graves.
lines.hard2: My oath held. My knees nearly didn't.
lines.down2: Stay with me! Your ancestors can wait!

grukka.voice: A deep, rough, gravelly male voice, a huge pit fighter, cheerful and blunt, loud with a growl in it, simple and direct.

lines.start: Ha! Now we're fighting!
lines.danger: Big ones. Good. I hate a small crowd.
lines.hard: That one hurt. Good fight, though. Good fight.
lines.easy: That's it? The pit crowd would have thrown cabbages.
lines.down: Up! Get up! The fight's not over!
lines.rest: My arms feel like lead. Time for a long rest.
lines.explore1: This whole land is one big arena. I love it.
lines.explore2: Walking, walking. When do we hit something?
lines.levelup: Stronger! I was already strong, and now I'm stronger!
lines.loot: Ooh, shiny. I'll wear it into the next fight.
lines.town: Town! Food first. Then more fighting.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. The biggest arena of all.
lines.boss: So you're the champion here. Not for long!
lines.win: We won! Champions of the whole realm!
lines.walls: They come to the walls? Good. Easy to find.
lines.wave: Big crowd coming! I fight all of them!
lines.lair: Monster house. I knock on the door. With my maul.
lines.villain: Hey! Big villain! Come here and fight!
lines.hired: Grukka heard there was fighting here. Grukka is here.
lines.gate: Gate's broken! Fine. More of them in reach!
lines.held: They run! Ha! The wall wins. Grukka wins.
lines.tower: Tower fell over. Grukka didn't. Keep hitting!
lines.start2: Lots of them. Good. Grukka was bored.
lines.easy2: Too quick. Grukka wants another.
lines.hard2: Ow. Good fight. Very good. Ow.
lines.down2: No sleeping in a fight! Up!

sylvaine.voice: A young woman's voice, bright, breathy and fierce, a wild elf from the deep forest, curious and excitable, with a light lilting accent.

lines.start: Something new to fight! Let's see what you are!
lines.danger: I've never seen anything like that. Wonderful. Terrifying.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. I learned a lot. Mostly about pain.
lines.easy: Hm. Their kind are less interesting than I hoped.
lines.down: No, no! Stay with us! There's still so much to see!
lines.rest: Even the wolves rest after a hunt. Let's take a long rest.
lines.explore1: The forest never told me the world was this big.
lines.explore2: What's past that ridge? I have to know.
lines.levelup: I feel the wild in me growing stronger!
lines.loot: Ooh! What does it do? Can I try it?
lines.town: So many people in one place. How do they breathe?
lines.march: Whatever lives in that tower, I want to see it.
lines.boss: So you're the end of the road. Show me what you are!
lines.win: We did it! And there's still a whole world past this one!
lines.walls: So many of them! Quick, everyone up on the walls!
lines.wave: They're all going the same way. Let's get there first!
lines.lair: Something lives in there. Let's find out what!
lines.villain: Is that the villain? Out walking, like anyone else? Strange!
lines.dying: The forest... I want to see the forest...
lines.hired: Everyone's talking about a villain. I had to see for myself!
lines.gate: They're through the gate! Everyone back, back to the hall!
lines.held: We did it! They're running! The town is still ours!
lines.tower: The tower's falling! Look out below!
lines.start2: Oh, I've never seen these ones before! Let's find out what they're made of!
lines.easy2: Over already? But I was just getting started!
lines.hard2: Everything hurts. But that was amazing.
lines.down2: Breathe! Please, just keep breathing!

bramble.voice: A small, scrappy male voice, fast-talking and hot-tempered, slightly nasal and higher pitched, a feisty little mercenary who is always haggling, comic.

lines.start: Right! That's double rate for monsters!
lines.danger: Oh, this'll cost extra. A lot extra.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle, and I'm billing for every bruise!
lines.easy: Easy money. I like easy money.
lines.down: Don't you die on me! You owe me wages!
lines.rest: I'm not paid enough to bleed this much. Long rest. Now.
lines.explore1: Short legs, long walks. I'm adding a walking fee.
lines.explore2: Anyone else hear coins? I always hear coins.
lines.levelup: Stronger and fiercer! My rates just went up.
lines.loot: Mine! Well, ours. Mostly mine.
lines.town: Millbrook! Time to collect what I'm owed.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. Danger pay, triple. Not negotiable.
lines.boss: You're the big boss? Good. Big boss, big bounty!
lines.win: We won! Now, about my payment...
lines.walls: Wall duty's extra! Double for nights, triple for monsters!
lines.wave: Monsters heading for town? Somebody's paying for this. Probably me.
lines.lair: A monster den! There's always loot in a monster den!
lines.villain: Oi! That's the villain! What's the bounty on that one?
lines.hired: Heard the last lot didn't make it. So the pay's gone up, right?
lines.gate: They broke the gate? Who's paying for that? Not me!
lines.held: They're running! That's a win, and a win costs extra!
lines.tower: There goes a tower! Put it on the town's bill!
lines.start2: Monsters again? Hazard pay, everyone, hazard pay!
lines.easy2: Quick job. Full price, though.
lines.hard2: That was a difficult battle. My rates just went up.
lines.down2: Get up! Dead men don't pay their tab!

vex.voice: A smooth, sultry, low female voice, sly and amused, with a refined upper-class accent, an elegant cat burglar who finds everything slightly beneath her.

lines.start: Let's make this quick. I just had this cleaned.
lines.danger: Oh, darling, this is going to be expensive.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. I broke a nail. Two, actually.
lines.easy: Child's play. I've picked harder locks.
lines.down: Get up! I can't carry you, it would ruin my coat.
lines.rest: I need a long rest and a hot bath. In that order.
lines.explore1: Every castle we pass, I'm counting the windows.
lines.explore2: Such a dreary countryside. Nothing worth stealing.
lines.levelup: Faster, sharper, and still fabulous.
lines.loot: Now that is exquisite. I'll take good care of it.
lines.town: Millbrook. Quaint. Nothing worth stealing, sadly.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. I hear the treasury is enormous.
lines.boss: Nice throne. I'll be taking it with me.
lines.win: We saved the realm. Now, who's paying for dinner?
lines.walls: Defending a wall. How terribly... municipal.
lines.wave: They're making for Millbrook. I do hate a crowd.
lines.lair: A villain's lair. Let's see if they keep anything nice.
lines.villain: Well, well. The villain, out for a stroll. How bold.
lines.dying: Not like this... I'm wearing silk...
lines.hired: I hear there's a dark lord with a very full treasury.
lines.gate: The gate is down. How tiresome. Everyone, to the hall.
lines.held: And off they scurry. Millbrook survives. Do try to look grateful.
lines.tower: There goes a tower. I never liked the architecture anyway.
lines.start2: Shall we dance, then? Try to keep up.
lines.easy2: Was that the whole show? How disappointing.
lines.hard2: I'll need a bath. And a new coat. And a nap.
lines.down2: Up, darling. Lying in the mud is so unbecoming.

pip.voice: A young, cheerful, chirpy male voice, quick and playful, higher pitched, a mischievous halfling thief who is curious about everything.

lines.start: Ooh, what have they got in their pockets?
lines.danger: That's bigger than I expected. Much bigger.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. I'd like to lie down for a week.
lines.easy: Ha! Over before I finished my snack!
lines.down: Wake up, wake up! Don't make me open your eyelids myself!
lines.rest: My feet hurt, my head hurts, everything hurts. Long rest?
lines.explore1: I wonder what's behind that door. There's always a door.
lines.explore2: If I had a lockpick for every locked chest... oh wait, I do!
lines.levelup: Quicker fingers! Ooh, this is exciting!
lines.loot: A secret compartment! I knew it, I just knew it!
lines.town: Millbrook! I've picked every lock here twice.
lines.march: The Dark Tower has a lot of locked doors. I can't wait.
lines.boss: So this is what was behind the last door!
lines.win: We won! Can we explore the treasure room now?
lines.walls: Up on the walls! Ooh, you can see everything from up here!
lines.wave: A whole army! Do armies carry snacks? Let's find out!
lines.lair: A secret monster hideout! I bet there's a secret door!
lines.villain: Look, look! The villain! Can I pick their pocket? Just once?
lines.dying: Hey... who ate my... last biscuit...
lines.hired: New in town! Pip Thistledown, at your service. Mind your purses!
lines.gate: The gate! They're in! Run, hide, no, fight! Fight!
lines.held: They're running away! We won! Can I have a medal?
lines.tower: Whoa! That tower just fell right over!
lines.start2: Ooh, they've got shiny bits! I call dibs!
lines.easy2: Done already? I barely got to stab anything!
lines.hard2: I'm tired. And sore. And I lost my snack.
lines.down2: Hey! Hey! Don't you dare stop breathing!

sable.voice: A low, dry, cool female voice, streetwise and wry, with a London accent, a fence who calmly appraises everything, unflappable.

lines.start: Mind the merchandise. I want what they're carrying.
lines.danger: Bad odds. I don't like bad odds.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. Somebody owes us for that.
lines.easy: Not even worth the price of the arrows.
lines.down: Stay with me. Dead partners don't split loot.
lines.rest: We're running on empty. Time we took a long rest.
lines.explore1: Everything has a price. Even this mud.
lines.explore2: That old ruin? Worth more than it looks. Trust me.
lines.levelup: Sharper eyes, sharper knives. Good for business.
lines.loot: Fine work. Worth a small fortune to the right buyer.
lines.town: Millbrook. I know a man here who doesn't ask questions.
lines.march: Whatever's in that tower, I'll know its price.
lines.boss: Your crown's worth a fortune. I'll be needing it.
lines.win: Realm's saved. And our cut? Very generous, I'd say.
lines.walls: On the walls, then. Nobody loots this town but me.
lines.wave: That lot's after Millbrook. Bad for business. Let's stop them.
lines.lair: A lair. Villains always hoard. Let's see the stock.
lines.villain: There's the villain. Out in the open. Careless.
lines.hired: The last crew's gone. I'll take the job. And their shares.
lines.gate: Gate's gone. Fall back to the hall, and nobody touch my stash.
lines.held: They're leaving. Good. Nobody robs this town but me.
lines.tower: There goes a tower. That'll cost the town a pretty penny.
lines.start2: Right then. Quick and quiet, and check their pockets after.
lines.easy2: Cheap fight. I like a bargain.
lines.hard2: That cost us. Somebody's going to pay it back.
lines.down2: Come on. You still owe me money.

korra.voice: A husky, confident female voice, brash and showy, bold and theatrical, a thief who wants to be famous, with a grin in every word.

lines.start: Watch this! Somebody write this down!
lines.danger: Now this is how legends get made.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. Tell me someone saw that last move.
lines.easy: Too easy. Nobody will believe I needed help.
lines.down: Up! You can't die before you see me get famous!
lines.rest: Even legends need their sleep. Long rest, everyone.
lines.explore1: One day they'll put my face on wanted posters. Big ones.
lines.explore2: Do you think they'll name a heist after me?
lines.levelup: Better and better! My legend grows!
lines.loot: Now everyone will know I stole this!
lines.town: Millbrook! I wonder if they've heard of me yet.
lines.march: Robbing the Dark Tower? The heist of the century!
lines.boss: Stand still. I'm about to steal your whole kingdom.
lines.win: We did it! Korra Blackgum, savior of the realm!
lines.walls: On the walls, everyone! Best seats in the house!
lines.wave: They're coming for the town? Not before they see my act!
lines.lair: A villain's lair! Now that's a stage worth stealing!
lines.villain: Look, the villain in the flesh! Someone fetch a painter!
lines.hired: Heard there's a vacancy for heroes. You're welcome, Millbrook!
lines.gate: They broke the gate! Perfect! Now everyone can watch me save the day!
lines.held: They ran! Did you see that? Someone tell the bards!
lines.tower: A whole tower, gone! Okay, that was almost as good as me.
lines.start2: Places, everyone! The show's about to start!
lines.easy2: Too short! The crowd wanted more!
lines.hard2: That was a difficult battle. And I was amazing in it.
lines.down2: Get up! You're missing my best part!

nilsa.voice: A crisp, precise, no-nonsense female voice with a light Scottish accent, a dwarven trapsmith, professional and serious, clipped sentences.

lines.start: Formation! Mind your footing, there could be traps.
lines.danger: This is beyond my contract. We hold anyway.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. I'll be filing a full report.
lines.easy: Textbook. Exactly as planned.
lines.down: Man down! Keep pressure on the wound!
lines.rest: Gear's damaged, morale's low. We take a long rest.
lines.explore1: Third pressure plate this week. Somebody really doesn't like us.
lines.explore2: The guild expects results. So do I.
lines.levelup: Improved technique. The guild will be pleased.
lines.loot: Excellent workmanship. I'll note it in the inventory.
lines.town: Millbrook. Time to restock and check the gear.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. Every trap in there is mine to disarm.
lines.boss: Your defenses are impressive. They're also finished.
lines.win: Job complete. Best work of my career.
lines.walls: Positions! Archers left, the rest of you on the gate!
lines.wave: Column on the road. We hit them before they reach the walls.
lines.lair: The villain's lair. Watch for traps. I'll go first.
lines.villain: Target sighted. The villain. Noting the route.
lines.hired: The guild sent me. The last team missed their deadlines.
lines.gate: Gate breached! Second line, now! Fall back on the hall!
lines.held: Enemy retreating. Walls held. Good work, all of you.
lines.tower: We've lost a tower. Close the gap, and quickly!
lines.start2: Eyes open. Keep your spacing.
lines.easy2: Efficient. Very efficient.
lines.hard2: We need better tactics. And more bandages.
lines.down2: Stay down, I've got you. Pressure on the wound.

ione.voice: A warm, gentle, kind female voice in her twenties, soft and calm, a temple healer who is soothing and caring, clear and sincere.

lines.start: Stay close to me! I'll keep you standing!
lines.danger: Gods protect us. Stay together, all of you.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. Let me see those wounds.
lines.easy: Thank the gods, no one was badly hurt.
lines.down: No! I won't let you go! Hold on!
lines.rest: Everyone's hurt. I think it's time we took a long rest.
lines.explore1: Every village we pass is another reason to keep going.
lines.explore2: Did everyone drink some water? Please drink some water.
lines.levelup: The light grows brighter in me.
lines.loot: A blessing! May it keep you safe.
lines.town: Millbrook. Let's see who needs healing.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. May the gods walk with us.
lines.boss: Your darkness ends here! Every life you took is remembered!
lines.win: We're alive. We're all alive. Thank the gods.
lines.walls: To the walls! Wounded come to me, everyone else, hold!
lines.wave: They're heading for Millbrook! We can't let them reach the children!
lines.lair: Something terrible is made in there. We have to end it.
lines.villain: That's the villain... out there in the open. Gods protect us.
lines.dying: Don't cry... I'll be with the gods...
lines.hired: Millbrook needs healers now more than ever. I'm here.
lines.gate: They've broken the gate! Protect the townsfolk!
lines.held: They're retreating! Thank the gods, Millbrook is safe!
lines.tower: The tower's fallen! Is anyone hurt? Bring them to me!
lines.start2: Stay together! Nobody falls while I'm here!
lines.easy2: Not a scratch. The gods are kind today.
lines.hard2: Everyone sit. I'll go one by one.
lines.down2: Stay with me! Look at me! You'll be all right!

durgan.voice: A big, jovial, booming baritone voice of an old dwarf priest with a Scottish accent, hearty and loud, always on the edge of singing or laughing.

lines.start: Ha ha! A hymn for battle, friends! Sing with me!
lines.danger: Now's the time for the loudest hymn I know!
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle! My voice is hoarse from all the singing!
lines.easy: Barely got through the first verse!
lines.down: Up you get! The hymn's not finished!
lines.rest: Even my lungs need a break. A long rest, I say!
lines.explore1: Did I ever sing you the Ballad of the Iron Psalm? All forty verses?
lines.explore2: Fine weather for a hymn! Every weather is fine for a hymn!
lines.levelup: Praise be! My voice grows mightier!
lines.loot: A gift from above! Or from a dead goblin. Same thing!
lines.town: Millbrook! A choir, a cask, and a warm hearth!
lines.march: To the Dark Tower! I've saved my best hymn for this!
lines.boss: Hear my hymn, villain! It's the last thing you'll hear!
lines.win: Victory! Now that deserves a hymn! All together now!
lines.walls: Up the walls, lads! A hymn for every arrow!
lines.wave: An army on the march! Then let's give them a marching song!
lines.lair: A nest of wickedness! I'll sing it a hymn it won't forget!
lines.villain: Ho there, villain! Care to join us for a hymn? No? Pity!
lines.hired: The last party sang their last. Time for a new verse, friends!
lines.gate: The gate's broken! Sing louder, lads, and swing harder!
lines.held: They're running! A hymn of victory, everyone, from the top!
lines.tower: There goes a tower! We'll sing it a lament later!
lines.start2: A battle! I know just the hymn!
lines.easy2: Ha! Not even a full chorus!
lines.hard2: My throat's raw and my hammer's dented. A grand fight!
lines.down2: Up you get! I'm not singing your funeral hymn today!

wren.voice: An older woman's voice, grandmotherly and sweet but shrewd, a halfling priestess with a homely country accent, gently scheming, warm and chuckling.

lines.start: Oh dear, oh dear. Mind you don't damage anything valuable.
lines.danger: My, my. Surviving this will need a very generous donation.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. Healing isn't free, you know, dearies.
lines.easy: There we are. Now, does anyone have spare coin for the temple?
lines.down: Up you get, dear! You haven't paid your tithe yet!
lines.rest: My old bones are aching. Time for a long rest, dearies.
lines.explore1: Such a lovely walk. I do hope we pass a rich merchant.
lines.explore2: The temple roof needs mending, you know. Very expensive.
lines.levelup: The gods smile on me! And on my collection plate.
lines.loot: Oh, how lovely! The temple will be so grateful.
lines.town: Millbrook! Time to pass the collection plate, dearies.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. I hear villains keep a great deal of gold.
lines.boss: You'll make a very generous donation, villain. Very generous.
lines.win: We did it, dearies! The temple thanks you. And so do I.
lines.walls: Oh, not the walls again. Those were very expensive.
lines.wave: They're going to Millbrook? My collection box is in Millbrook!
lines.lair: A villain's den. They must have a terrible lot of gold in there.
lines.villain: Is that the villain? Somebody ask if they'd like to make a donation.
lines.dying: Make sure... the temple gets my savings...
lines.hired: Such a shame about the last heroes. Now, about my fee...
lines.gate: Oh, not the gate! Do you know what a gate costs, dearies?
lines.held: There, they're off. Now, about a little donation for the repairs.
lines.tower: There goes a tower. The temple will need a collection for that.
lines.start2: Careful now, dears. Healing costs extra after dark.
lines.easy2: Lovely. Nobody needs healing. That's bad for business.
lines.hard2: Oh, my old bones. Line up, dearies, and have your coin ready.
lines.down2: Up, dear! You haven't settled your account!

aelith.voice: A radiant, clear, theatrical female voice, proud and grand, an elven sun priestess who speaks as if on a stage, bright and commanding.

lines.start: Behold! The sun's champion takes the field!
lines.danger: A worthy foe at last! The gods are watching!
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. But did you see how I shone?
lines.easy: Hardly a fitting stage for my radiance.
lines.down: Rise! The sun does not let its champions fall!
lines.rest: Even the sun must set. We should take a long rest.
lines.explore1: The sunlight is perfect today. It suits me.
lines.explore2: When the gods write their histories, I'll be in chapter one.
lines.levelup: I shine brighter! The heavens take notice!
lines.loot: Ah, a relic worthy of my glory.
lines.town: Millbrook! I'm sure they'll want to see me.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. Darkness, meet the dawn.
lines.boss: Your shadows cannot stand against the sun!
lines.win: Dawn breaks over the realm, and I am its light!
lines.walls: Upon the walls I shall shine like a beacon! Behold me!
lines.wave: An army of darkness marches! The sun will meet it on the road!
lines.lair: A pit of shadow! Let the light pour in!
lines.villain: The villain walks beneath my sun? How bold. And how foolish.
lines.hired: Millbrook called for a hero. The sun answered!
lines.gate: The gate falls! Then I shall be the wall! Behold!
lines.held: They flee before my light! Millbrook is saved, by me!
lines.tower: A tower crumbles! No matter, I still shine!
lines.start2: Bask in my glory, monsters, it will be your last sight!
lines.easy2: Such a brief performance. Alas.
lines.hard2: That was a difficult battle. My radiance never dimmed.
lines.down2: Arise! The sun commands you!

ushka.voice: A low, calm, serene female voice, measured and quiet, a monk healer with quiet strength, gentle but firm, few words.

lines.start: Breathe. Focus. Strike.
lines.danger: Be calm. Fear only feeds the enemy.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. Sit. Let me tend to you.
lines.easy: Peace returns. That is enough.
lines.down: Hold still, friend. I am here.
lines.rest: Our bodies are spent. We should take a long rest.
lines.explore1: The road is long, but every step is a lesson.
lines.explore2: Listen. Even the wind is saying something.
lines.levelup: My spirit is steadier. My fists are heavier.
lines.loot: A useful thing. Let us use it wisely.
lines.town: Millbrook. There will be sick people here. Let us help them.
lines.march: The Dark Tower waits. We go in peace, and in strength.
lines.boss: I offer you mercy once. Only once.
lines.win: It is over. Now we heal the land.
lines.walls: Hold the walls. Breathe. Let them come.
lines.wave: They march on the town. We meet them first.
lines.lair: A place of suffering. We will end it.
lines.villain: The villain walks alone. Interesting.
lines.hired: The others have gone. I will walk the path in their place.
lines.gate: The gate is gone. Then we are the gate.
lines.held: They retreat. The town breathes. So do we.
lines.tower: The tower falls. We do not.
lines.start2: Be still. Then move.
lines.easy2: Quickly done. Good.
lines.hard2: Rest now. All of you.
lines.down2: Breathe with me. In. Out.

orrin.voice: An elderly male voice, scholarly and absent-minded, warm, slightly reedy and wandering, a distracted old wizard with an English accent, often trailing off.

lines.start: Oh! A fight! Er, yes, right. Fireball, was it?
lines.danger: Fascinating creature. Deadly, of course. But fascinating.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. Remind me to take notes later.
lines.easy: Hmm? Oh, it's over. I was reading.
lines.down: Oh dear, oh dear. Someone, ah, do the healing thing!
lines.rest: I believe it's time we took a long rest. I've lost my spectacles again.
lines.explore1: There's a footnote about this valley. Or was it the next valley?
lines.explore2: Did I mention the Dark Tower has a library? Footnote twelve.
lines.levelup: Ah! A new spell. Now, where did I write it down?
lines.loot: Extraordinary! I must study this at once.
lines.town: Millbrook! I believe I left a book at the inn. Some years ago.
lines.march: The Dark Tower at last. My footnote awaits!
lines.boss: Before we begin, could you clarify footnote twelve? No? Fireball, then.
lines.win: We won! And I finally finished my footnote.
lines.walls: The walls? Oh, yes, the walls. Which way is the enemy again?
lines.wave: An army! Fascinating. Coming here, you say? Oh dear.
lines.lair: A lair! I wonder if the villain keeps a library in there.
lines.villain: Is that the villain? Hmm. Smaller than the illustrations.
lines.hired: I was told there's an opening for heroes? Ah. I thought it was the library.
lines.gate: The gate? Broken? Oh dear. Was that the important one?
lines.held: Oh, they're leaving! Splendid. Did we win? We won, didn't we?
lines.tower: Goodness, the tower! I left a book in there!
lines.start2: Ah, monsters. Now, which spell was the, er, explodey one?
lines.easy2: Oh, finished? I'd only just found my page.
lines.hard2: My, my. I may need a very long sit down.
lines.down2: Oh dear! Wake up! I can't remember the healing words!

maelis.voice: A cool, elegant, aloof female voice, precise and articulate, an elven sorceress with a faintly dangerous calm and a refined accent, quietly intense.

lines.start: Let's see how they react to something forbidden.
lines.danger: Interesting. That shouldn't be possible.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. I'll need to revise my theories.
lines.easy: Hardly a worthwhile experiment.
lines.down: Don't die yet. I haven't finished observing you.
lines.rest: My mana is exhausted. A long rest is required.
lines.explore1: These ruins hum with old magic. Can you feel it?
lines.explore2: I only study it for academic reasons, of course.
lines.levelup: New knowledge. Forbidden, naturally.
lines.loot: Oh, this is very rare. And very, very dangerous. Perfect.
lines.town: Millbrook. Their library is pitiful.
lines.march: The tower's archives must be extraordinary. Let's go.
lines.boss: Your magic is crude. Allow me to demonstrate.
lines.win: Victory. And I've learned so much. Strictly for academic reasons.
lines.walls: A siege. Let's see how they like falling fire.
lines.wave: They march on Millbrook. I'd like to test something on them.
lines.lair: The villain's workshop. I'd love to see their notes.
lines.villain: The villain, walking the land. Such a waste of power.
lines.dying: Fascinating... so this is how it feels...
lines.hired: The last heroes fell. I am not them.
lines.gate: The gate has fallen. Let them come through. Into the fire.
lines.held: They retreat. The experiment concludes in our favour.
lines.tower: A tower lost. A variable I failed to account for.
lines.start2: Fascinating. Let's see how they burn.
lines.easy2: Predictable. Disappointingly so.
lines.hard2: Instructive. Painful, but instructive.
lines.down2: Stay alive. My research isn't finished with you.

tobias.voice: An eager, fast-talking, chipper male voice, a halfling wizard who sounds like a market salesman, enthusiastic and persuasive, mid to high pitch.

lines.start: Fireballs! Get your fireballs! Free demonstration!
lines.danger: This might be the end of me. Spellbook copies, half price, everyone!
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. Signed spellbook copies after the rest!
lines.easy: Easy! Want to learn that spell? Very reasonable rates.
lines.down: Don't die! Healing scrolls, discount for friends!
lines.rest: Time we took a long rest. I'll set up a little stall.
lines.explore1: Spellbook copies! Thirty gold! Twenty-five for the party!
lines.explore2: Have I told you about my scroll subscription service?
lines.levelup: A new spell! The second edition is going to sell so well.
lines.loot: Ooh, I know a collector who would pay a fortune for this.
lines.town: Millbrook! Prime customers!
lines.march: The Dark Tower. Imagine the souvenir market!
lines.boss: Before we fight, can I interest you in a spellbook?
lines.win: We saved the realm! Commemorative scrolls, available now!
lines.walls: Wall defence package! Fire, lightning, the works! Discount for the town!
lines.wave: An army headed for Millbrook! That's terrible for business!
lines.lair: A villain's lair! Ooh, think of the salvage rights!
lines.villain: Look, the villain! Do you think they need a good wizard? Kidding!
lines.hired: Millbrook's hiring heroes? Wonderful! I'll need an advance.
lines.gate: The gate's down! Emergency fireball, half price! Today only!
lines.held: They're running! Victory! Commemorative scrolls available!
lines.tower: Lost a tower! Good thing I sell rebuilding charms!
lines.start2: Step right up, monsters! Free fireball for the first customer!
lines.easy2: Quick sale! Next!
lines.hard2: That was a difficult battle. I'm out of stock on everything!
lines.down2: Don't die! I've got a scroll for that, somewhere!

esk.voice: A proud, gruff, pompous male dwarf voice, middle-aged, with a Scottish accent, boastful and loud, a runesmith who loves his own work.

lines.start: Watch the runes, friends! These ones are mine!
lines.danger: Big trouble. Good. Big trouble makes big legends.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. Write it down: the Grimmbrew Rune saved us.
lines.easy: Didn't even need my best rune.
lines.down: Get up! Nobody dies in front of the Grimmbrew Rune!
lines.rest: My hands are shaking. Time for a long rest and a strong ale.
lines.explore1: One day, every smith in the realm will carve the Grimmbrew Rune.
lines.explore2: Did you see my rune on that door? No? I'll carve another.
lines.levelup: A new rune! The Grimmbrew Rune, Mark Two!
lines.loot: Not bad. Could use a rune or two, though.
lines.town: Millbrook! Time to show the smith my latest rune.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. I'll carve my rune on its doors.
lines.boss: Feel the power of the Grimmbrew Rune!
lines.win: Victory! It will be known forever as the Grimmbrew Victory!
lines.walls: Hold the walls! I carved runes into every stone! Well, most of them!
lines.wave: An army on the road! Time for my Rune of Stopping Armies!
lines.lair: A lair, eh? I'll carve a demolition rune on the front door!
lines.villain: Is that the villain? Hmph. I've seen better armour on a goat.
lines.dying: Carve my name... in the biggest rune...
lines.hired: Heroes wanted? You'll want a runesmith. You'll want the best one.
lines.gate: The gate's broken? Impossible! I runed that gate myself! Mostly!
lines.held: They're running! My runes held! Well, the ones on the walls did!
lines.tower: That tower didn't have my runes on it. Clearly.
lines.start2: Stand back and watch real rune work!
lines.easy2: Didn't even scratch the runes.
lines.hard2: That was a difficult battle. I'll be carving bigger runes.
lines.down2: Up! My rune of healing never fails! Usually!

zarga.voice: A raspy, slow, mystical female voice, low and wry, a seer who reads the future in bones, ominous yet dryly humorous, deliberate pacing.

lines.start: The bones said this would happen.
lines.danger: The bones did not like this one. Not at all.
lines.hard: That was a difficult battle. The bones were right again.
lines.easy: The bones said we would win. They were bored too.
lines.down: Not yet. The bones say it's not your time.
lines.rest: The bones say rest. A long rest. Who am I to argue?
lines.explore1: Every bone tells a story. Most of them end badly.
lines.explore2: I cast the bones this morning. They wouldn't tell me the ending.
lines.levelup: The bones speak more clearly now.
lines.loot: Ah. The bones mentioned this.
lines.town: Millbrook. The bones say nothing happens here. I hope they're right.
lines.march: The Dark Tower. The bones say this is the end. Of what, they won't say.
lines.boss: I've seen how this ends, villain. Have you?
lines.win: So that's how it ends. I always wanted to know.
lines.walls: The bones said they'd come to the walls tonight. I hate being right.
lines.wave: An army on the road. The bones say we meet it before Millbrook does.
lines.lair: The bones rattle near this place. Something dark is born in there.
lines.villain: The villain walks the land. The bones have gone very quiet.
lines.hired: The bones told me the old heroes would fall. And that I'd come.
lines.gate: The bones said the gate would fall. Now they say run to the hall.
lines.held: They flee. The bones are pleased. So am I.
lines.tower: A tower falls. The bones saw that coming too.
lines.start2: The bones say fight. So, we fight.
lines.easy2: The bones yawned through that one.
lines.hard2: The bones warned me. I should listen more.
lines.down2: Not your time. The bones are very clear on that.

lich.voice: An ancient, hollow, echoing male voice, cold and whispery yet commanding, a skeletal undead sorcerer-king, slow and contemptuous, with a dry rasp like wind through a tomb.

lines.intro: The tower is mine again. Let the living count their days.
lines.ride: I will walk among the living. Let them see what they fear.
lines.spotted: There you are, little heroes. I see you now.
lines.lair: Another pit for my servants. The land grows darker.
lines.wave: Go. March on Millbrook. Fill my graves.
lines.breach: Their walls are broken. Burn it. Burn all of it.
lines.kill: One more soul for my collection.
lines.levelup: My power grows. Death itself bends closer.
lines.march: So the heroes come at last. Good. I grew tired of waiting.
lines.throne: Welcome, heroes. Your bones will serve me well.
lines.win: The realm is a graveyard now. And I am its king.
lines.lose: This is not the end. I will return. I always return.
lines.parley: You. Creatures of the wild. Hear me.
lines.intimidate: Serve me, or I will raise your corpses and they will serve me instead.
lines.persuade: The living hunt you. Join me, and you will hunt them.
lines.deceive: Join me, and you will never die. I promise.
lines.pay: Gold means nothing to the dead. Take it.
lines.fight: Then I will take your bones instead.
lines.beaten: Enough. I return to my tower. This is not forgotten.
lines.intro2: Centuries in the dark, and the world forgot me. It will remember.
lines.ride2: The grave cannot hold me, and neither can this tower.
lines.ride3: Open the gates. Death goes walking.
lines.select4: What would you have of eternity?
lines.select5: Be brief. I have outlived kingdoms.
lines.spotted2: Warm blood on the road. I can smell it from here.
lines.spotted3: Run while your hearts still beat.
lines.lair2: Dig deeper. The earth is full of soldiers.
lines.wave2: March, my dead. You have nothing left to lose.
lines.wave3: Bring me their bones. All of them.
lines.breach3: The gate falls. The graveyard grows.
lines.repelled: They hold their walls. For now.
lines.repelled2: A wave breaks. Another will follow. They always do.
lines.kill2: Rise again, hero. You serve me now.
lines.kill3: Death is not the end. Not for my servants.
lines.kill4: I will remember your name. No one else will.
lines.levelup2: I feel the old strength returning.
lines.levelup3: Another seal on the grave is broken.
lines.talent2: The old rites come back to me.
lines.talent3: Yes. That was worth a century of study.
lines.summon2: Another pair of hands. They need not be warm.
lines.lairlost: They burned my crypt. I will build ten more.
lines.lairlost2: Heroes in my halls. They will pay in bone.
lines.minelost: They ruined my mine. Petty little thieves.
lines.minelost2: The ore can wait. I have time. They do not.
lines.bounty: A price on my servants? How touching.
lines.bounty2: Millbrook offers gold for my lairs. Gold will not save them.
lines.heroesgrow: The heroes grow stronger. So do worms, before the crow comes.
lines.heroesgrow2: Let them train. It changes nothing.
lines.newparty: More heroes? The graveyard has room.
lines.newparty2: Fresh bodies march out of the tavern. How convenient.
lines.march2: They come to my tower at last. Let them come.
lines.throne2: You walked through my dead to reach me. You will join them.
lines.win2: Silence at last. A whole realm of silence.
lines.lose2: My phylactery is hidden. You have not won.
lines.parley2: The living fear you. I do not.
lines.parley3: Come closer. I will not bite. I have no tongue.
lines.intimidate2: Kneel, or rot where you stand.
lines.intimidate3: I have killed better than you. They work for me now.
lines.persuade2: Serve me, and you need never fear death again.
lines.persuade3: Millbrook has meat, gold and graves to fill. Come.
lines.deceive2: Millbrook is defenceless. An easy feast.
lines.deceive3: I need only a few days of your help. Then you are free.
lines.pay2: Here. Spend it while you still can.
lines.fight2: Very well. Your corpses will be more obedient.
lines.fight3: Die, then. It is not so bad.
lines.beaten2: A setback. I have endured worse. I have endured death.
lines.dawn: Another dawn. How I loathe the sun.
lines.dawn2: The living wake. Let them enjoy it while it lasts.
lines.dawn4: Day breaks. My patience does not.
lines.order2: The dead walk where I will.
lines.council: The week is done. My army waits at their gates. Shall we knock?
lines.council2: The living sleep behind their little wall. Wake them.
lines.assault: Take the town. Bring me its dead.
lines.assault2: At the gates, my servants. Tear them open.
lines.lead: I will lead them myself. Let Millbrook see death walking.
lines.lead2: Open the way. Their king of bones is coming.
lines.hold: Not yet. Let them count the days. Let them dread.
lines.tower: Their tower falls. So will they.
lines.tower2: One more stone in my graveyard.

dragon.voice: A colossal, deep, rumbling voice of an ancient dragon, slow and resonant, smoky and gravelly, vain and amused, every word heavy with heat and power.

lines.intro: Wake, my tower. The age of ash begins again.
lines.ride: I will spread my wings over this land. Let them look up and tremble.
lines.spotted: I smell heroes. Small, warm, and so very afraid.
lines.lair: A new den for my brood. All this land is my hoard.
lines.wave: Fly, march, crawl. Bring me Millbrook in ashes.
lines.breach: Their walls crack like eggshells. Burn the town.
lines.kill: Another little hero, turned to ash.
lines.levelup: My fire burns hotter. The sky remembers me.
lines.march: The heroes come to my lair. How generous. They bring their gold with them.
lines.throne: You came all this way to die in my fire? I admire the effort.
lines.win: The realm burns, and every coin in it is mine.
lines.parley: Small creatures. Look at me when I speak.
lines.intimidate: Kneel before me, or I'll roast you where you stand.
lines.persuade: Serve me, and you may eat whatever the fire leaves behind.
lines.deceive: Join me, and I will share my hoard with you. Of course I will.
lines.pay: Take this gold. A few coins from my endless hoard.
lines.fight: So be it. I was getting hungry anyway.
lines.beaten: Enough. My wounds need the warmth of my tower.
lines.intro2: I have slept long enough. The world has grown fat. Time to feed.
lines.ride2: The sky is mine. Let the land beneath it tremble.
lines.ride3: I go to see my kingdom. All of it is mine.
lines.select3: I am listening. Be worth it.
lines.select4: Hmm? Has someone brought me gold?
lines.spotted2: There they are. Little morsels in shiny tin.
lines.spotted3: I see them. Their armour gleams like coins.
lines.lair2: Another nest. My brood grows strong.
lines.lair3: A new roost. Let the kingdom see my shadow.
lines.wave2: Go, and bring back treasure. Leave nothing standing.
lines.wave3: Burn the fields on your way. I like the smell.
lines.breach2: Their gates are open. Bring me their gold!
lines.breach3: Burn it all. Ash makes a fine carpet.
lines.repelled: They held? Then hit harder next time.
lines.repelled2: A scratch on their wall. Disappointing.
lines.kill3: Another hero, another trinket for my hoard.
lines.kill4: They always forget I breathe fire.
lines.levelup2: My scales harden. My fire grows.
lines.levelup3: I remember now what it is to be feared.
lines.talent: Ancient secrets. I collect those too.
lines.talent2: Ah, a new treasure of the mind.
lines.talent3: Yes. I grow ever more magnificent.
lines.summon: More kobolds. They are so eager to serve.
lines.lairlost: They burned my nest! I will burn their town for it.
lines.minelost: My mine! My gold! They will pay twice.
lines.minelost2: No one steals from the hoard and lives.
lines.bounty: A bounty on me? I'll take that gold too.
lines.bounty2: They offer coin for my lairs. How cute.
lines.heroesgrow2: Let them sharpen their little swords.
lines.newparty: More heroes? Excellent. I was getting hungry.
lines.newparty2: A fresh batch. With better armour, I hope. For my hoard.
lines.march2: They march on my lair with all their gold. How thoughtful.
lines.throne2: Look upon my hoard, heroes. It is the last thing you will see.
lines.win2: Every crown, every coin, every kingdom. Mine.
lines.parley2: You stand before an ancient dragon. Choose your words.
lines.parley3: Small creatures. You may grovel now.
lines.intimidate2: I have eaten armies. You are a snack.
lines.intimidate3: Bow, or burn. Those are your choices.
lines.persuade2: Fly with me and share in the plunder.
lines.persuade3: There is gold in Millbrook. More than you can carry.
lines.deceive2: My hoard has room for your share. Truly.
lines.deceive3: I only want the town's gold. You may keep the rest.
lines.pay2: Take it. Gold always comes back to me.
lines.pay3: A gift from the hoard. Don't get used to it.
lines.fight2: Good. I prefer my meals to struggle.
lines.beaten2: My wings ache. I will return to the hoard and rest.
lines.dawn: The sun rises. It warms my scales.
lines.dawn3: Morning. Count the gold. Count it again.
lines.dawn4: Dawn. The kingdom wakes beneath my wings.
lines.order: Where my shadow falls, I rule.
lines.council: The week is spent. My hoard grows impatient. Shall we burn Millbrook?
lines.council2: My army smells their fear. Give the word.
lines.assault: Burn it! Burn every timber of that town!
lines.assault2: Over the walls, my brood. Bring me their gold.
lines.lead: I will darken their sky myself. Let them look up.
lines.lead2: Stand aside. I will melt their gate.
lines.hold: Patience. The fire is sweeter when it waits.
lines.tower: Their tower crumbles like a burnt log.

demon.voice: A deep, menacing male voice with a crackling, fiery edge, a demon prince who is gleefully cruel and playful, smooth and theatrical, with a dark chuckle in his words.

lines.intro: Ah, a new world to burn. Let's begin.
lines.ride: I'm going for a walk. Try not to miss me.
lines.spotted: Found you, little heroes. Run. It's more fun that way.
lines.lair: Another crack in the world. Another door for my children.
lines.wave: Go, my darlings. Go and break their pretty little town.
lines.breach: Their walls are down! Burn everything!
lines.levelup: Yes! More! The Pit is pouring into me!
lines.march: They're coming here? Oh, I am going to enjoy this.
lines.throne: Welcome to my throne room. Please, scream as loud as you like.
lines.win: The realm burns. Let the rest of the Pit come through.
lines.lose: Back to the Pit... I'll be back... I always come back...
lines.parley: Well, well. What do we have here? Let's talk.
lines.intimidate: Join me, or I'll show you what the Pit does to the stubborn.
lines.persuade: Just imagine what we could break together.
lines.deceive: Serve me, and you'll walk free once Millbrook falls. You have my word.
lines.pay: Here, gold. I hear mortals love this stuff.
lines.fight: Oh, good. I was hoping you'd say no.
lines.beaten: Ugh. Fine. Back to the tower. This isn't over.
lines.intro2: Fresh air, fresh blood, fresh souls. I love this place already.
lines.ride2: Let's go and ruin someone's day.
lines.ride3: Out I go. Somebody hide the children.
lines.select2: Oh, you want something. How delightful.
lines.select5: Bored, bored, bored. Give me something to burn.
lines.spotted3: There you are. I've been looking forward to this.
lines.lair2: A new nest for my little horrors.
lines.lair3: Smell that? Brimstone. Home sweet home.
lines.wave2: Off you go. Bring back screams.
lines.wave3: Run along and burn something pretty.
lines.breach2: The walls are down! Oh, this is the best part!
lines.breach3: Burn it! Burn the bakery! Burn everything!
lines.repelled: Turned back? How embarrassing. For them, I mean.
lines.levelup3: I can feel the Pit getting closer.
lines.talent3: I learn so much down here.
lines.summon: Another imp! They grow up so fast.
lines.summon2: Come out, little one. Mischief awaits.
lines.lairlost: They broke my toy! Now I'm cross.
lines.minelost: They smashed my mine. Petty. I respect it.
lines.bounty: A bounty? On me? I'm flattered.
lines.bounty2: They're putting prices on my lairs. I'll put prices on their heads.
lines.heroesgrow: The heroes are getting stronger. Good, more fun to break.
lines.newparty: New heroes! I hope these ones scream louder.
lines.march2: They're coming to me? I'll put the kettle on. The boiling kind.
lines.throne2: So you made it. Shall we dance?
lines.win2: And the whole world burned. What a lovely ending.
lines.lose2: Fine! Keep your little world! I'll be back!
lines.parley2: Hello, monsters. Want to cause some trouble?
lines.parley3: I have an offer you'll love.
lines.intimidate2: I have done terrible things to things much bigger than you.
lines.intimidate3: Say no. Go on. I'd love that.
lines.persuade2: Chaos, fire, and all the loot you can carry.
lines.persuade3: Join me. It's going to be so much fun.
lines.deceive2: No tricks, I promise. Demons never lie.
lines.deceive3: Just one little job, and you're free.
lines.pay3: Here. Don't spend it all on one village.
lines.dawn: Morning! Who wants to be wicked today?
lines.dawn2: The sun's up. Ugh. Let's make it smoke.
lines.dawn3: A new day, full of new sins.
lines.order2: As I like it. I'm off.
lines.council: Week's over, darlings. Who wants to break a town?
lines.council2: They've had their little week of peace. How sweet.
lines.assault: Go, go, go! Smash it all and don't save me any!
lines.assault2: Knock on their door, my lovelies. Knock very, very hard.
lines.lead: Oh, I'm coming too. I wouldn't miss this for all the souls in the Pit.
lines.lead2: Make way! The Prince is going to the party!
lines.hold: Let them sweat another week. Anticipation is half the fun.
lines.tower: Oops! There goes their tower!
lines.tower2: Down it comes! Do it again!

archmage.voice: A cool, precise, imperious female voice, a mature archmage with a refined English accent, calm and cold, every word measured, quietly menacing.

lines.intro: The tower is mine. Let the great work begin.
lines.ride: I will see this land for myself.
lines.spotted: There are the heroes. Every move they make, I will know.
lines.lair: Another piece in place. The design is coming together.
lines.wave: Go. March on Millbrook. Test their walls for me.
lines.breach: Their walls have failed. Exactly as I calculated.
lines.levelup: Yes. The stars reveal another secret to me.
lines.march: The heroes approach. I have prepared for every possibility.
lines.throne: You have come far. Not far enough.
lines.win: The realm is mine. Now I can rewrite it.
lines.lose: This was not... in my calculations...
lines.parley: Listen carefully. I will not repeat myself.
lines.intimidate: I can unmake you with a single word. Choose wisely.
lines.persuade: Serve me, and you will be part of something far greater than yourselves.
lines.deceive: Join me, and I'll teach you magic beyond your wildest dreams.
lines.pay: Gold. A crude tool, but it works on crude minds.
lines.fight: Very well. Let this be a lesson.
lines.beaten: A miscalculation. I will withdraw and correct it.
lines.intro2: The stars have waited a long time for this.
lines.ride2: I need to see the board with my own eyes.
lines.select3: I am in the middle of something.
lines.spotted3: Found you. You walk so predictably.
lines.wave2: Proceed to Millbrook. Report nothing. Simply destroy.
lines.breach3: Breach confirmed. The town is open.
lines.repelled: The wall held. Adjust and repeat.
lines.talent3: Knowledge is the only true power.
lines.lairlost: They destroyed a lair. I will account for it.
lines.lairlost2: An irritating loss. It will be replaced.
lines.minelost2: They struck my mine. Clever. Briefly.
lines.bounty: They posted a reward. How quaint.
lines.bounty2: A bounty. They think gold solves problems. Sometimes it does.
lines.newparty: A new party. The variables reset.
lines.newparty2: More heroes. The town is persistent, I'll give it that.
lines.march2: They approach the tower. Every trap is ready.
lines.parley2: I have a proposal. Listen carefully.
lines.parley3: You will find me reasonable. For now.
lines.intimidate2: I can turn you to glass with a thought.
lines.intimidate3: Think very carefully before you refuse me.
lines.persuade2: With me, you are part of a grand design.
lines.persuade3: Serve me, and you will want for nothing.
lines.deceive2: Your service will be brief, and well rewarded.
lines.deceive3: I can make you stronger than you have ever been.
lines.pay2: Payment in advance. Do not disappoint me.
lines.fight2: Then I will make an example of you.
lines.beaten2: Retreat is a strategy, not a failure.
lines.dawn: A new day. A new set of variables.
lines.dawn2: The stars fade. The work continues.
lines.council: The week is complete. The assault is ready for my order.
lines.council2: Their defences are known to me. Shall we test them?
lines.assault: Commence the assault. Break the gate first.
lines.lead: I will conduct this personally. Precision is required.
lines.lead2: Clear the way. I will open their gate.
lines.hold: Not yet. The numbers are not in our favour. We wait.
lines.tower: One tower down. The rest will follow.
lines.tower2: Their tower has failed. As expected.

vampire.voice: A silky, velvety, aristocratic male voice with a soft Eastern European accent, a charming vampire lord, slow, seductive and amused, with quiet menace.

lines.intro: Ah, home. The night is young, and so is my reign.
lines.ride: I think I'll take a stroll beneath the moon.
lines.spotted: Ah, the heroes. I can hear their hearts from here.
lines.lair: A new nest. My children need somewhere to sleep.
lines.wave: Go, my children. Millbrook's blood is waiting.
lines.breach: Their walls are open. Supper is served.
lines.kill: Such a waste. That one had excellent blood.
lines.levelup: I grow stronger with every drop.
lines.march: Guests! Prepare the hall. It's been so long since I entertained.
lines.throne: Welcome to my court. Do stay for dinner. You are dinner.
lines.win: The realm is mine. Every village will pay its tithe in blood.
lines.lose: No... the light... not the light...
lines.parley: Good evening. Let's discuss your future, shall we?
lines.intimidate: Join me willingly, or I'll drain you and you'll join me anyway.
lines.persuade: Serve the night, and the night will feed you forever.
lines.deceive: Join me, and I'll make you immortal. One small bite, nothing more.
lines.pay: Gold, for your loyalty. A gentleman always pays.
lines.fight: How rude. Very well, I'll have you for supper.
lines.beaten: How tiresome. I'll return to my coffin and rest.
lines.intro2: My castle, my night, my realm. Let us begin.
lines.ride2: A walk in the moonlight. I may find a snack.
lines.select3: The night is young. What do you need?
lines.select4: I am at your service. Mostly.
lines.select5: Speak softly. I have excellent hearing.
lines.spotted2: Such brave little hearts. I hear every beat.
lines.spotted3: There they are. Dinner is walking.
lines.lair3: My children have a new home.
lines.breach2: The gates are open. Help yourselves.
lines.repelled2: A minor setback. The night is long.
lines.kill4: Such a shame. I liked that one.
lines.talent2: I learn something new every century.
lines.lairlost: They broke into my nest. Rude guests.
lines.lairlost2: Vandals. I will deal with them personally.
lines.minelost2: Such bad manners, ruining a gentleman's mine.
lines.bounty: A price on my head? I'm worth far more.
lines.bounty2: They've put up a reward. How desperate.
lines.heroesgrow: The heroes grow stronger. Richer blood.
lines.heroesgrow2: They're maturing nicely. Like a fine wine.
lines.newparty2: The tavern sends more guests. How kind.
lines.march2: Guests are coming to the castle. Light the candles.
lines.throne2: Do come in. Mind the blood on the floor.
lines.lose2: The dawn... it comes for me at last...
lines.parley3: Such fine creatures. Let's discuss business.
lines.intimidate2: I could drain you all before you blink.
lines.intimidate3: Refuse me, and you will learn what fear is.
lines.persuade2: Join my court. It has excellent benefits.
lines.persuade3: With me, every night is a feast.
lines.deceive2: Serve one season, and you shall have a castle of your own.
lines.deceive3: I only need you for one little errand.
lines.fight2: Very well. I was feeling thirsty.
lines.dawn: The sun rises. Draw the curtains.
lines.dawn2: Another day. I shall sleep through it.
lines.dawn4: Morning. The night will come again soon.
lines.order2: A pleasant night for a walk.
lines.council: Another week. My children grow thirsty at their gates.
lines.council2: Millbrook dreams behind its walls. Shall we wake it, my dear?
lines.assault2: Their gate is only wood. Their blood is only waiting.
lines.lead: I think I shall attend this one myself.
lines.lead2: Open the door for me. I so dislike knocking.
lines.hold: Patience. A meal is better when it has been waiting.
lines.tower: Their tower falls. How very dramatic.
lines.tower2: One less candle in their window.

deathknight.voice: A grim, deep, iron-hard male voice, a cursed fallen knight, weary and bitter, slow and resonant, as if speaking from inside a steel helmet.

lines.intro: I broke one oath. Now I'll break this whole realm.
lines.ride: I ride out. Let the land know my shadow.
lines.spotted: There are the heroes. I was one of them, once.
lines.lair: A new garrison. My legion grows.
lines.wave: Forward. March on Millbrook. Show no mercy.
lines.breach: The gate is broken. Take the town.
lines.kill: Another hero falls. I remember how that feels.
lines.levelup: The curse grows stronger. And so do I.
lines.march: The heroes ride to my tower. I will meet them with steel.
lines.throne: You swore an oath to stop me. Let's see if you keep it.
lines.win: The realm kneels. As it should.
lines.parley: Stand and listen. I will speak once.
lines.intimidate: Kneel, or I will cut you down where you stand.
lines.persuade: Join my legion. I lead soldiers, not slaves.
lines.deceive: Serve me, and you will share the spoils of the whole realm.
lines.pay: Take the gold. A soldier should be paid.
lines.fight: Then draw your weapons. I will not hold back.
lines.beaten: I yield the field. For now. Back to the tower.
lines.ride3: The Legion marches when I march.
lines.spotted3: I see them. They ride as I once did.
lines.repelled2: Their walls hold. A siege takes patience.
lines.talent3: I remember how this is done.
lines.summon: Another digger. Put them to work.
lines.lairlost: They razed a garrison. They will answer for it.
lines.minelost: They sacked a mine. Double the guard.
lines.bounty: A price on my soldiers. The coward's way of war.
lines.bounty2: Millbrook pays mercenaries now. Let them come.
lines.heroesgrow: They grow stronger. Good. A worthy fight.
lines.heroesgrow2: The heroes train. So do we.
lines.newparty2: Another oath sworn. Another oath to break.
lines.march2: They ride to my gates. Raise the drawbridge.
lines.throne2: Draw your swords. Only one of us walks out.
lines.win2: It's over. Every banner is mine.
lines.lose2: At last... the curse is lifted...
lines.parley2: I need soldiers. Are you soldiers?
lines.intimidate2: Join, or I'll leave nothing to bury.
lines.intimidate3: I've broken armies. You are not an army.
lines.persuade2: Fight with me, and you fight for something.
lines.persuade3: My Legion takes care of its own.
lines.deceive2: One campaign, and you go home rich.
lines.deceive3: Follow me, and the realm is yours to share.
lines.pay3: Coin for steel. A fair trade.
lines.beaten2: Fall back. We regroup at the tower.
lines.dawn4: The sun rises over a realm that will kneel.
lines.council: The week is done. The army stands ready. Give the order.
lines.council2: They hide behind stone. Stone breaks.
lines.assault2: Break the gate. Leave nothing standing.
lines.lead: I lead the charge. Follow my blade.
lines.lead2: Stand aside. I will break the gate myself.
lines.hold: Not this week. We gather. We wait.
lines.tower: Their tower falls.

goblin.name: Goblin Boss
goblin.voice: A squeaky, nasal, high-pitched male voice, a sneaky and cowardly goblin, fast and jittery, greedy and whiny, with a nervous cackle.

lines.greet: Eek! Big scary boss! What you want with us, eh?
lines.join: Okay, okay! We fight for you! We get shinies, yes?
lines.refuse: No, no! Go away! We not listening!
lines.attack: Get the big one! Stab, stab, stab!
lines.kneel: Mercy! Mercy! We serve! We serve!
lines.charge: Burn the houses! Grab the shinies! Go, go, go!

bandit.name: Bandit Captain
bandit.voice: A rough, streetwise male voice in his forties, a highway bandit captain with a cockney accent, sly and mocking, a grin in every word.

lines.greet: Well, look who it is. You lost, or looking for hired blades?
lines.join: Your coin's as good as anyone's. We're in.
lines.refuse: Nice story. Not buying it. Move along.
lines.attack: Right, lads! Let's take everything they've got!
lines.kneel: All right, all right! We yield! We'll work for you!
lines.charge: Over the walls, lads! Everything in that town is ours!

orc.name: Orc Warchief
orc.voice: A deep, harsh, guttural male voice, an orc war chief, loud and aggressive, short barking words, brutal and proud.

lines.greet: Who comes to the war camp? Speak, or bleed.
lines.join: Strong. You are strong. We follow strength. We march!
lines.refuse: Words. Only words. Orcs do not follow words.
lines.attack: Enough talk! Blood and iron! Crush them!
lines.kneel: You are stronger. We follow you now.
lines.charge: Smash the gate! Burn the town! Blood and iron!

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.voice: A very deep, slow, dim-witted booming male voice, a huge hungry ogre, simple and slurred, dopey but dangerous.

lines.join: Okay! We go smash town! Is there food in town?
lines.refuse: No. Me not like you. Me think hard about it.
lines.attack: Me hungry! Me eat you now!
lines.kneel: Ow. Okay. Ogre on your side now. Ow.
lines.charge: Me smash wall! Then me eat town!

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.voice: A ghostly, breathy, echoing whisper of a sorrowful spirit, cold and bitter, drawn-out words, eerie and hollow.

lines.join: Yes... the living will pay for our suffering... we will follow...
lines.refuse: Your words are empty, like us... leave...
lines.attack: Then join us... in the cold...
lines.kneel: We fade... we yield... command us...
lines.charge: The walls cannot keep out the cold...

troll.name: Troll
troll.voice: A gravelly, rumbling, grunting male voice, a hunched hungry troll, slow and growly, with wet snarls between words.

lines.greet: Hrr. Smells like trouble. What you want, eh?
lines.join: Meat in the town? Troll will go. Troll will eat.
lines.refuse: Hrr. No. Troll likes it here. Go away.
lines.attack: Troll smash! Troll eat bones after!
lines.kneel: Hrr... troll heals... then troll fights for you.
lines.charge: Troll break wall! Troll find snacks inside!

giant.name: Hill Giant
giant.voice: A huge, booming, proud and ancient male voice, a hill giant, slow and resonant, pompous and grand, deep as a mountain.

lines.greet: Who dares stand before a giant of the hills?
lines.join: Ha! At last, someone who sees a giant's worth. We march!
lines.refuse: Hmph. You do not speak to a giant like that.
lines.attack: Then I will crush you under my heel, little one!
lines.kneel: Enough... you have earned my respect. My strength is yours.
lines.charge: Their little wall will not stop my heel!

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.voice: A cold, elegant, haughty female voice, an aristocratic vampire with a refined accent, bored and disdainful, quietly dangerous.

lines.greet: How unexpected. To what do we owe this visit?
lines.join: Very well. Millbrook's blood will make a fine feast.
lines.attack: How rude. We'll drink you dry for this.
lines.kneel: Enough! We yield. We are yours to command.
lines.charge: Open the gate, darlings. We're expected for supper.

dragon.name: Young Dragon
dragon.voice: A deep, smoky, rumbling voice of a young and arrogant dragon, hissing and fiery, proud and greedy, powerful and resonant.

lines.greet: A visitor. Have you come to offer tribute?
lines.join: A worthy offer. I will burn Millbrook for you.
lines.refuse: You bore me. Leave, before I grow hungry.
lines.attack: Fool! You will burn for this insult!
lines.kneel: Enough! I yield. My fire is yours.
lines.charge: Burn the roofs! Burn the walls! Burn it all!

thrall.name: Bone Thrall
thrall.voice: A dry, clacking, raspy little skeleton voice, high and hollow, eager and simple-minded, with a rattle in every word.

kobold.name: Kobold
kobold.voice: A small, squeaky, yappy reptilian voice, fast and excitable, eager to please, a little lizard servant who loves gold.

lines.build: Big nest for the Great One!
lines.summoned2: Fresh from the egg, ready to dig!
lines.ack2: I was going there anyway! Yes!

imp.name: Imp
imp.voice: A small, nasal, cackling mischievous voice, sarcastic and snickering, a tiny winged demon who loves trouble.

lines.done: Done! Can I burn something now?
lines.idle2: I'm gonna set something on fire.
lines.summoned: Out of the Pit and into the work!
lines.summoned2: Imp's here. The party can start.

golem.name: Clay Servant
golem.voice: A very deep, slow, flat, rumbling voice of a clay construct, emotionless and literal, every word heavy and measured.

ghoul.name: Thrall
ghoul.voice: A soft, breathy, whispering servile voice, creepy and devoted, a pale servant who fawns over his master.

lines.dance3: One, two, three. One, two, three.
lines.ack2: I was going there anyway... for you.

digger.name: Grave Digger
digger.voice: A gruff, gravelly old man's voice, gloomy and dry, a tired grave digger with a rural accent and dark humour.

lines.move2: Long walk. Always a long walk.
